## Receive a Mattermost message when a user updates their profile on Facebook

**Purpose**: n8n workflow: Receive a Mattermost message when a user updates their profile on Facebook. 3 nodes wired together. Uses: facebookTrigger, mattermost, stopAndError. Sourced from czlonkowski/Zie619 n8n-workflows community archive (workflows/Facebook/0123_Facebook_Mattermost_Update_Triggered.json). Configure credentials and any hardcoded IDs before activating.

**Services needed**: facebookTrigger, mattermost, stopAndError

**Difficulty**: auto-deploy

**Setup**:
1. Configure credentials for the services above
2. Update any hardcoded IDs / URLs
3. Test with sample data before activating

_Source: https://github.com/Zie619/n8n-workflows_
